candidate_workaround: Before generating self-excluding staged manifests, remove only the declared receipt paths from the index and assert their staged intersection is empty.
failure_signature: The final staged-review generator refused because all five self-excluding receipt paths were already staged.
recurrence_guard: Stage intended inputs, unstage only declared self-excluding outputs, assert zero staged intersections, then generate and restage the receipts.
rollback: Retain the refused generator at zero credit and leave working-tree receipt content available until the exact index contract is restored.
scope_boundary: Additive staged-manifest receipt generation only; no history rewrite or working-tree deletion.
title: Honor staged-manifest self-exclusion before generation
trigger_preconditions: A staged-review generator declares its own output receipts as index self-exclusions.
